fuel_materials: Liquid fuel droplets; verify fuel species per run
hardware: Multi-user Droplet Combustion Apparatus (MDCA) in Combustion Integrated Rack (CIR)
relevance_notes: Relevant to gaseous suppression mechanisms, but droplet flames are not equivalent to solid-material fires.

name: Cool Flames Investigation with Gases
description: Cool-flame combustion research with gaseous fuels and oxygen-nitrogen mixtures; challenge brief notes oxygen flow up to 85% in selected tests.
objectives: Investigate cool-flame combustion with gaseous fuels
fuel_materials: Propane or other gaseous fuel; verify individual tests
hardware: ACME hardware in Combustion Integrated Rack (CIR)
relevance_notes: Potentially useful for high-oxygen combustion physics. The cited 85% refers to an oxygen-nitrogen stream in the burner configuration, not necessarily a chamber-wide atmosphere concentration.

field_evidence.oxygen_pct: Challenge description reports up to 85% oxygen in the oxygen-nitrogen mixture flowing from the spherical burner; do not generalize to chamber oxygen percentage.

name: Smoke Point In Co-flow Experiment
description: Microgravity gaseous-fuel flame research relevant to smoke point and soot formation.
objectives: Investigate smoke point and soot behavior in co-flow flames
fuel_materials: Gaseous fuel; verify fuel species per test
hardware: Microgravity Science Glovebox (MSG) fan-driven flow duct
measurements: Flame and soot behavior; verify exact variables
relevance_notes: Potentially relevant to smoke characterization, but not a substitute for smoke detector validation.

name: Structure & Liftoff In Combustion Experiment

measurements: Flame structure and liftoff; verify exact variables
